context: Whole group celebrates Hina's exam success; many warm voices.
purpose: Big celebration of teen's educational milestone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ひな、合格、本当におめでとう!
lines.en: Hina — congratulations, truly. I'm so proud of you.
lines.style: Warm, admiring opening. Soft voice carries real tenderness without performing it. Breath of genuine delight on the name. Steady, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ありがとう、皆のおかげ!
lines.en: Thank you — I couldn't have done it without all of you.
lines.style: Bright, effusive joy breaking through. Open on the first word. Quick pace carrying momentum. Genuine gratitude, not polite. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Strong Kansai warmth. Direct, proud — no softening. Solid on the affirmation. Steady, grounded tone. The warmth of someone who celebrates without making it awkward.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Wide-eyed childlike awe. Soft voice but full of wonder. Quick, bouncy delivery. The genuine amazement of a younger brother who truly believes his sister is extraordinary.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: We've got to celebrate this properly, don't we!
lines.style: Big, booming Kansai energy. Laughing underneath the words. Volume and generosity, not performative — this is how she loves. Eager, sweeping gesture in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: I watched you work for this. Every step.
lines.style: Quiet, maternal weight. Slow delivery. Each phrase a small affirmation. Not effusive — just steady witnessing. The voice of someone who has seen and remembers.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, sincere. Slight pause before the second sentence — processing the realness of it. Warm underlayer. Not congratulating the achievement so much as affirming the person who achieved it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Your support — all of you — it meant everything to me.
lines.style: Emotion rising carefully. Voice thins slightly with gratitude. Breath catching gently. Slows on the weight of it. Tearful but controlled — the voice of someone feeling deeply and expressing it quietly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: これから、ずっと応援するよ。
lines.en: From this moment on, I'll be cheering for you always.
lines.style: Steady, earnest promise. Warm but grounded. No flourish — just quiet conviction. The voice of someone making a vow, not a gesture. Breath even and present.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Soft Kansai philosophy. Unhurried, reflective. Weight of genuine feeling underneath — not sentimental, but real. The voice of someone who's lived enough to know what matters. Slight trailing-off, like finishing a thought to himself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえちゃん、お祝い、僕も!
lines.en: Big sis — I want to celebrate too!
lines.style: Small but insistent pride. Quick, eager rhythm. Voice reaches up slightly — wanting to be part of the moment. Childlike sincerity, not cuteness. The urgency of wanting to participate in something big.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Ha — look at all of you. You're adorable.
lines.style: Warm Kansai laugh opening the line. Fond, unsarcastic. Brightness and generosity underneath. Observant — she sees the whole moment. Not mocking, just delighted by the family she's in.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Thank you. Truly, from the bottom of my heart.
lines.style: Quiet, sincere closing. Slowed pace on the last phrase — letting each word land. Voice softens further. Not grand, but genuinely moved. The voice of someone who has felt the weight of being supported and is giving thanks that means something.
